_comment: Series-level identity. The title is a WORKING TITLE; change it here and nowhere else. Credits and the company line are rendered on every end card in this order: fact card, title lockup, written-by, company mark with motto.

endCard._comment: Seconds. The take ends at T. Cards anchored in the spec may begin before T (e.g. end-2.5). After T the engine holds the title lockup for titleHoldSeconds, then written-by, then the company mark. Episode length = T + titleHoldSeconds + writtenBySeconds + companySeconds.
